name: AskJeles
description: Jeles, your AI librarian. Search the verified web — Smithsonian, Library of Congress, NASA, NIH, and more. No SEO slop. No ads. Just authoritative knowledge, deposited into The Binder.
author: Sean Campbell

data_streams.purpose: Process your search queries against verified sources
data_streams.description: Queries cleared when session ends — not stored or used for training

data_streams.purpose: Save search findings to your local Binder
data_streams.description: Only deposited if you explicitly choose to save — stored in local Binder database

dev_server.note: Also requires --serve flag. Local development only. Not started in production.

notes: network_read is used only for fetching from the verified source list (Smithsonian, LoC, NASA, etc.). No data sent upstream. binder_write deposits findings into the local Binder (requires Binder consent separately).
